closure: Generation 61 did not launch a Strategy Tester backtest. Its first data-export stage merely initialized the FundedNext terminal through the Python MT5 API and failed immediately because 2017 M1 history was not available through copy_rates_range. Owner explicitly noticed the mismatch. Generation 62 corrects the execution method: it uses the actual MetaTrader 5 Strategy Tester from the FundedNext installation for frozen R6B-347 and R6B-307, one candidate per run, M1 tester period, 1-minute OHLC modelling, 2016-12 warmup, active strategy window 2017-01-01 through 2026-07-31, optimization disabled. The harness can place orders only when MQL_TESTER is true; live trading is disabled in the launch config. It refuses to stop or reuse an already-open FundedNext terminal and waits up to 20 minutes for the visible terminal to be closed. After both tester runs, an analyzer computes full/year/month/rolling PF/net/DD/streak and pair diagnostics. No parameter tuning.

jobs.description: Cold static audit of the two actual MT5 Strategy Tester harnesses and launcher. Confirms exact frozen R6B-347/R6B-307 parameters, tester-only order guard, 2017-Jul2026 active interval, optimization disabled, M1/1-minute-OHLC tester configuration, and safe refusal to terminate an already-open FundedNext terminal.

Run real MetaTrader 5 Strategy Tester backtests on FundedNext for frozen R6B-347 then R6B-307. The tester downloads missing history as needed. Orders are confined to MQL_TESTER, optimization is off, 1-minute OHLC is sufficient because signals use closed M5 bars and entries/exits occur on M1 opens. The harness never deploys to a live chart or live account.

Analyze the actual MT5 tester trade CSVs for both candidates: full net/PF/win rate/drawdown/ex-best-trade, yearly and monthly stability, rolling 6m/12m windows, streaks, Jan-Jul 2026 behavior, monthly correlation and a simple equal-1-lot combined diagnostic. Descriptive only; no retuning or live deployment.
